name: alazord
description: Alazord's Claude Code plugins — Slack triage and other workflow tools.

plugins.name: slacklens
plugins.description: Personal Slack triage dashboard for Claude Code. Status-driven routing: each thread card shows a one-line "what to do" inferred by Claude from the whole thread (Hinglish supported), routed into board/waiting/done/dropped lanes by inferred status with ownership/grounding/commitment rules (R1–R4). Four-tier priority scoring — a priority contact's direct message outranks a fresh casual ping. Cache schema v3 with per-thread inference cached by last-message-ts. Relative time labels from reliable unix-epoch timestamps. Pinned search limits, permalink dedupe, atomic cache writes with backup + suspicious-refresh guard. DELTA refresh. Stale-cache warnings. Token-cost instrumentation in the refresh log.
